annotations.title: Quote the credit price of a video

description: The exact credit price of a video BEFORE it is made. Read-only: nothing is created, reserved or charged. Tell the user the price, then call the creating tool. mode "motion_clip": one moving clip from a prompt (autoshort_generate_motion_clip), by duration and resolution; also says whether this account can start it now (canStart, blockedBy). mode "stills": a normal narrated video made of still images (autoshort_generate_chat_video, or tool "autoshort_generate_video"). Also returns the balance, whether it covers the price, and this key's remaining daily spending cap. approxUsd: the credits converted to USD at what one credit is worth on your plan (a conversion of the plan price; only credits are charged). Free.

duration.description: Seconds: the clip length (motion_clip, 4-12) or the video length (stills, 8-90).

model.description: motion_clip only: price the clip on this model ("seedance" is the default).

tool.description: stills only: which tool to price (default autoshort_generate_chat_video).
